durabilitytweaks.title: Durability Tweaks
durabilitytweaks.subtitle: Armor colour follows its durability · by betongoat
durabilitytweaks.reset.tooltip: Restore every setting to its default value.
durabilitytweaks.option.enabled.tooltip: Turns all armor colouring on or off.
durabilitytweaks.option.style.tooltip:
Full colour: the whole armor takes the durability colour (classic dura pack).
Outline: the armor keeps its look, only its edges are coloured.
No colour: armor stays vanilla - combine it with the number.
durabilitytweaks.option.palette.tooltip: Colour scale used for the durability bands.
durabilitytweaks.option.outline.tooltip: Width of the coloured border in the Outline style.
durabilitytweaks.option.number.tooltip: Paints the remaining durability onto the armor, like the number packs.
durabilitytweaks.option.format.tooltip: Percent of durability left, or the exact durability points left.
durabilitytweaks.option.show_at_full.too: Also show the number on undamaged armor. Without it, full armor looks completely vanilla.
durabilitytweaks.option.filter.tooltip: Which armor gets coloured. Netherite changes colour every 10% down to 20%, then every 5%. Everything else changes every 10% down to 10%, plus two extra colours for intense PvP (10-5% and 5-0%).
durabilitytweaks.preview.tooltip: Only changes the preview, not your settings.
